annotations.title: Electric cars in Poland (Eurostat, GUS, UDT)

description: Battery electric (BEV) and plug-in hybrid (PHEV) passenger cars in Poland: fleet at year end and new cars in the year with shares (Eurostat), fuel mix of new cars, provinces and counties per 1000 passenger cars with top and bottom counties (GUS BDL, when the county series is available), and the correlation of public charging sites per 10k residents with BEV per 1000 cars across counties, with a 95% interval and a version controlling the median wage. Correlation is not causation. Index finwire_ev_share_new_cars. For charging points use get_ev_charging.

counties.description: Include every county (about 380 rows); default false = top and bottom 10.
